  "implementation": "def solve(case):
    threshold = case['threshold']
    calls = case['calls']
    accepted = []
    diagnostics = []
    for c in calls:
        call_id = c['call_id']
        loss_without = c['loss_without_call']
        loss_with = c['loss_with_call']
        tokens = c['prediction_tokens']
        parseable = c['parseable']
        gain = loss_without - loss_with
        normalized_gain = gain / tokens
        accepted_flag = parseable and normalized_gain >= threshold
        if accepted_flag:
            accepted.append(call_id)
        diagnostics.append({'call_id': call_id, 'accepted': accepted_flag, 'normalized_gain': normalized_gain})
    return {'accepted_call_ids': accepted, 'diagnostics': diagnostics}"
}
